travelSays.line: 🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."
📋 A woman, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
👂 Overheard — Lucas: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
